name: fal Image
author: hearth-team
description: Image generation via fal.ai — fast serverless inference for Flux, SDXL, SD3, IP-Adapter, ControlNet, and inpaint/outpaint variants. Pass `model` to pick an endpoint (default fal-ai/flux/schnell). Single prompt → image saved to /dashboard/collateral.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

vault_inputs.label: fal API Key
vault_inputs.help: From fal.ai → Dashboard → Keys. Looks like 'abc:def…'. Stored encrypted.
